footprint.symmetry: asymmetrical; towers create vertical emphasis on left side

repeated_patterns: Construct large wooden deck platform at ground level with vertical wood plank pattern
Add small window openings to tower faces in regular grid pattern
raw_hints: Build three tall towers (approximately 3 blocks wide each) on the left side using dark stonebrick
Create horizontal banding across main structure using alternating wood and stone materials
Construct large wooden deck platform at ground level with vertical wood plank pattern
Use white/light concrete blocks for foundation and support pillars beneath deck
Space towers with gaps between them for visual separation
Add small window openings to tower faces in regular grid pattern
Maintain flat roofline across entire structure
Ensure L-shaped footprint with towers extending higher than main horizontal section
rebuild_intent.summary: A multi-story modern building with a distinctive L-shaped footprint featuring three tall dark stone towers on the left side and a horizontal striped main structure. The building combines stonebrick and wood materials with horizontal banding patterns. A large wooden deck platform extends from the front, supported by concrete pillars. The structure sits on a raised foundation with white concrete blocks.
